items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Before I went uptown, I heard Clarence Profit and Bobby Henderson play.

ctx.x: little groups, you know. So after that, this guy started to do everything on...taking me all over... Getting my face rubbed and all that! I said, "Oh well" -- I started playing the piano!
So, I remember when I started playing it sounded pretty good, and the rest of the time I... Before I went uptown, I heard Clarence Profit and Bobby Henderson play. That's the next...
